slides.title: What Is Different
slides.body: BLS will not publish 12-month changes for October 2026 where October 2025 data is missing. The 2025 shutdown stopped price collection.

slides.title: The Key Numbers
slides.subtitle: Monthly CPI change (%)
slides.body: September yearly CPI was 3.7% (core 2.6%). *Economist estimates; they vary by source.

slides.title: Why It Matters
slides.body: Markets already lean toward a hike. Without a yearly rate, the monthly figures carry more weight. Odds are market estimates (Nov 6), not Fed decisions.
